snippet.title: GalanWarSong // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3545810/GalanWarSong/

A hardcore turn-based strategy game based on chess and with RPG elements. Players will play the role of the "Legendary King" Bordo Dia, summon former mercenary partners, go to Galan Castle, defeat the sin dragon, and save the world.

Developed by
winwill工作室 aka @winwill-Studio ​
